stem: Container-mass tracking shows steady water loss, but one embedded moisture sensor reports almost no dryback for several days. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Trust the embedded sensor because electronic moisture data should take priority over container-mass trends when the two disagree
Increase irrigation frequency from the sensor reading because a lack of reported dryback indicates the root zone is staying too wet and requires smaller intervals between events
Discard the container-mass records because whole-container weight cannot distinguish water loss from changes in plant biomass
Verify sensor placement and function and compare repeat measurements before changing irrigation in response to the conflicting signals
rationale: Conflicting measurements should trigger verification. Sensor placement or function can produce unrepresentative readings, so a management change should wait until the discrepancy is resolved.
